title: PrivateSnapshotManifest
description: One snapshot of the owner's private teams (ADR-015 section 2): the Parquet shards that hold its PrivateTeamRecords, the cells of its active records, the record counts, the hold-out rule and its key, and the snapshot it extends. It mirrors TeamSnapshotManifest with the data class private, no dataset hashes, one split (owner), the label set, the counts and the hold-out block. Every string is a hash, an id token or a fixed word: no team content can ride in it. The snapshot hash is SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of this whole object and names the snapshot in the bucket (snapshots/<snapshot_hash>/manifest.json, shards at snapshots/<snapshot_hash>/shards/<index>.parquet; a shard carries its index, never its path, as the path holds the hash of this object). logical_snapshot_hash is SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of {shards: the sorted shard logical hashes, cells, label_set_hash, manifest, holdout, and parent_snapshot_hash or first: true}. Exactly one of parent_snapshot_hash and first, the shard order and indices, the cell ranges tiling each shard, the sums, the counts and the logical hash are enforced by the reader (the contract profile cannot compute them). The reader needs no secret: the hold-out key is not one (it makes the split stable and not hand-picked).

data_class.description: Always private. The data-class guard refuses this label everywhere except at the exact corpus sample paths it lists (ADR-015 section 6).

parent_snapshot_hash.description: The snapshot hash of the snapshot this one extends. Present exactly when first is absent (reader-enforced).

first.description: True on the first snapshot, which has no parent. Present exactly when parent_snapshot_hash is absent (reader-enforced).

vocabulary_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the TeamVocabulary the teams were validated against.

label_set_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the TeamLabelSet the labels and cells come from.

logical_snapshot_hash.description: The writer-independent identity of the snapshot.

shard_key.description: The HMAC key that assigns a team to a shard, as hex. Not a secret: it fixes the layout.

shards.description: The shards in fixed order: by logical hash. The index of a shard is its position.

cells.description: Active rows per cell, sorted by stratum, unique. A cell with no active record is not listed, so the list is empty when every record is retired.

split.description: The only split of a private snapshot.

rows.description: Active records in the cell across the shards.

records.description: The record counts of the snapshot (reader-checked against the shards and cells).

holdout.description: The hold-out rule of the snapshot (ADR-015 section 2): a record is held out when the first 8 bytes (big endian) of HMAC-SHA256(key as bytes, team_id as its 32 hex characters) are below ppm / 10^6 of 2^64. Generated once at the first import, copied unchanged from the parent after. The key is not a secret.

rule.description: The derivation. Another rule is another version of this word.

ppm.description: The held-out share in parts per million.

writer.description: What wrote the shard files; a writer change changes file bytes, never logical hashes.

parquet_schema_version.description: The version of the column layout the shards use.

VersionManifest.description: Replay identity of a battle (ADR-003, ADR-007): the pinned engine commit, the format, and the hashes of the engine ruleset and of Areneon's own format rules.

ruleset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical engine ruleset.

format_rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of Areneon's format rules record (ADR-007).

Shard.description: One immutable shard file of the snapshot.

index.description: The shard's position, 0 first: the object is snapshots/<snapshot_hash>/shards/<index>.parquet.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the shard file's bytes.

logical_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the sorted list of the shard's record hashes.

rows.description: Rows (records, active and retired) in the shard.

split.description: The only split of a private snapshot.

cell_ranges.description: Each cell's contiguous rows in the shard, in stratum order; together they tile the shard.

first_row.description: The first row of the range.

active_rows.description: Rows of the range with status active, at most rows.
